scripts.build: export MIMALLOC_ALLOW_THP=0 && npm run build -w @dreamspan/client && npm run build -w @dreamspan/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/test/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/e2e && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/perf
scripts.test: MIMALLOC_ALLOW_THP=0 vitest run --project shared --project client --project server --tags-filter=!slow
scripts.test:slow: export MIMALLOC_ALLOW_THP=0 && vitest run --project server-slow; files=$?; vitest run --project shared --project client --project server --tags-filter=slow && exit $files
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test -c packages/client/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:browser:all: npm run build && playwright test -c packages/client/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:perf: MIMALLOC_ALLOW_THP=0 VITE_PERF=1 npm run build && MIMALLOC_ALLOW_THP=0 playwright test -c packages/client/perf/playwright.config.ts
